name: Spellfire Robes
summary: In the Undercity, Spellfire Robes mark a young Horde mage's rite of passage. Josef Gregorian, a tailor, completes the robes after the apprentice gathers rare components from across the realm.

sections.title: A Mage's Vestment
sections.body: In Lordaeron, you seek more than ordinary cloth to channel and shield your growing magic. Josef Gregorian works as a tailor in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, where he weaves magical garments from specialized materials gathered by promising Horde spellcasters. The final stitching marks your passage beyond basic incantations toward mastery of arcane and fire magic.

sections.title: Woven Power
sections.body: Josef Gregorian needs alchemical and arcane components to make robes that focus powerful magic. You gather those supplies through dangerous trials and bring them to his sanctum in the Undercity. There, Gregorian weaves them together, giving you a sign of growing status and protection as an aspiring mage.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Spellfire Robes quest?
faq.answer: This rite is the final step in an early class rite for Horde mages. After gathering tailoring components, you receive specially enchanted robes from Josef Gregorian.
Josef Gregorian is a Forsaken tailor in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He stitches the first proper class garments for newly minted mages sent to him by Anastasia Hartwell.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
aliases: where to turn in spellfire robes
faq.answer: The interaction takes place in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, at Josef Gregorian's tailor shop.

faq.q: Why don't you have to leave to do another task for this quest?
faq.answer: You gathered the materials in the preceding assignment, Gathering Materials. Hand the reagents to Josef, and he weaves the garment and gives you the finished robes.

faq.q: Can classes other than Mages obtain these robes?
faq.answer: No. The chain and its enchanted robes are for mages allied with the Horde.

faq.q: What materials were required to make these robes?
faq.answer: The robes use rare supplies gathered earlier, including linen cloth and Dalaran mana gems taken from the Kirin Tor mages of Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: As a Horde mage, you receive these robes as an early rite of passage. Their tailored cloth can handle volatile fire and arcane energies.
As a Forsaken spellcaster in the Undercity, you preserve Dalaran-style arcane discipline, joining old magical traditions with your new existence in Lordaeron's ruins.
As a tailor, you can see how mundane cloth is strengthened to withstand powerful magical currents with exotic reagents.
